text:
alex: quick q — onboarding for Orchid Health wants full-request log purge after 30 days and zero-PII retention. Do we have an off-the-shelf path to do this across request logs, traces, and debug dumps? pinging @maria and @sam for ops details.

maria: short answer: yes-ish. We redact PII in the pipeline, and request logs have TTL. But debug dumps stored in S3 may need manual scrub + delete job. We can automate if it's recurring.

sam: which config controls request log TTL? is it `LOG_RETENTION_DAYS` in log-shipper? also what about trace sampling retention?

maria: log-shipper env var `LOG_RETENTION_DAYS` (in deploy config); streaming pipeline is kinesis -> s3 -> es and TTL is enforced at ES index level via ILM. Traces are handled by `trace-cleaner` with `TRACE_RETENTION_HOURS`. Debug dumps and ad-hoc traces in s3 need scrub + delete. For tenant deletes we use `scripts/delete-tenant-data`.

chen: approvals: for customer-triggered deletions we need Security + Legal signoff and a Jira ticket (SEC-DEL). If it's in-contract (privacy clause) we fast-track but still need both. Ops runs scrubber and we verify via audit hashes.

alex: ok how to request? is there a self-service deletion flow?

maria: not self-serve yet. Steps: create Jira SEC-DEL with tenant id, data types (logs/traces/dumps), time range; tag `ops-oncall` + `legal`; include retention policy reference. Ops will dry-run then live-run. Example commands we use:

```
# dry-run
scripts/delete-tenant-data --tenant orchid --dry-run --since 30d
# live (requires approvals)
scripts/delete-tenant-data --tenant orchid --since 30d --approve SEC_SIG
```

sam: who can approve `SEC_SIG`? list of approvers?

chen: approvers are @maria, @dave-legal, and @sec-lead. For sandbox/dev dry-runs ops can run without legal, but live needs one sec + one legal.

alex: orchid wants this within 48h. timeline realistic?

maria: dry-run <2h after ticket. Live deletion 24-48h once approvals and we coordinate S3 lifecycle if needed. I'll open the SEC-DEL and cc legal now.

sec-bot: note: deletion runs are recorded in audit log id DEL-1802-ORCHID; S3 objects scheduled for lifecycle purge will show tag `delete-request:DEL-1802-ORCHID`.

alex: thanks, I'll file the customer request and paste the SEC-DEL link here. :thumbsup:
